title: Offline confirmation of two single-variable retrieval changes against the MQL-0011 R3 hybrid: X1 neighbour-voted structure cues, X2 dense without BM25
type: offline structural retrieval proxy; NOT execution accuracy; no model generation; no Atlas
origin: hypotheses from the post-hoc MQL-0011 dev diagnostic (chat report 2026-11-22; scripts and output in the session scratchpad: mql0011_diag.py, mql0011_diag2.py, mql0011_diag_out.json). The MQL-0011 dev split is NOT used for confirmation.

x0.selection: all 90 MQL-0010 build databases; MQL-0010 item rule + spider-pool-v3 membership; no sampling

retrieval_view.policy: leave-target-database-out per query; holdout DBs physically absent; no question-level exclusion pairs (MQL-0011 policy)

data.embedding_artifact_and_store: MQL-0011 artifact + Qdrant collection mql0011__v2_1_view2912__bge_small_en_v1_5__5c38ec7c__masked_q, opened read-only (verify-on-open; no writes), exact local search, CanonicalScorer re-scoring
data.gold_use: gold SQL (signature) and corpus MQL (skeleton) of X0 items are used for METRICS only

vote.neighbours: top 10 distinct documents of the candidate universe U (target DB excluded, forbidden DBs absent) by (-round(canonical cosine, 6), doc_id), after the existing duplicate collapse (doc_id, repr(mql), normalised question)
vote.not_voted: select, where (ignored by retrieval.jaccard); text_number (database property)
vote.weighting: unweighted: each neighbour gives one vote per label in its corpus `patterns`
vote.rule: label predicted iff 2*votes > n (n = 10): strict majority, >= 6 of 10; 5/5 tie excluded; confidence = votes/n (reported only)
vote.no_support: empty predicted set (no structural cue), identical to a question where no regex cue fires
vote.schema_rules: unchanged from patterns.question_cues and UNIONED: join if >= 2 target collections mentioned; text_number if the target schema has text-typed numeric fields
vote.representation: {'select'} | predicted | schema_rule labels, passed to the unchanged retrieval.jaccard
vote.frozen: k = 10 and the threshold are fixed here; not tuned on X0 or on dev

X2.note: BM25 is never constructed or called; U = [view examples with db_id != target], identical (ids, order) to retrieval.Retriever._index_for
X2.deviation_from_brief: The brief asked for 'the existing dense-only ranking mode' AND preserved regex Jaccard at weight 1.0. MQL-0011's dense_only mode ranks by cosine with NO Jaccard, so it cannot satisfy both. X2 therefore uses channels=('dense',) with the unchanged regex Jaccard: identical to R3 except that the BM25 term is removed from L.

R0.role: descriptive historical reference only (no confirmatory test)
R0.implementation: retriever_v2.StructureAwareRetriever baseline (MQL-0010 D0 ranking), via DenseHybridRetriever(lexical='bm25')

shared.selection: top-3 of the ranking (no diversity), as in the MQL-0011 screen
shared.ranks: competition ranking on 6-decimal scores over U

metrics.structure_match: PRIMARY. hit@3 over attainable X0 items: some top-3 doc has exactly the item's gold structure signature (structure.signature(patterns.sql_patterns(gold SQL))); attainable = the gold signature occurs in the 2,912-record view (MQL-0011 definition)
metrics.pipeline_shape: hit@3 over X0 items that are corpus records (they have a corpus MQL): some top-3 doc has the same pipeline stage-operator sequence (MQL-0011 skeleton definition)
metrics.join_subgroup: attainable X0 items whose gold signature contains 'join'
metrics.descriptive: R0; hit@1, mJ@3; subgroup table (simple, join, group_by, order/limit, ungrouped aggregate); paraphrase-twin split (MQL-0011 definition: identical masked text or canonical cosine >= 0.95 with the same gold signature; biased, descriptive only); cue precision/recall of regex vs vote against the gold signature; candidate-set and top-3 overlap; latency

statistics.pairing: identical X0 items for every arm

bootstrap.ci: percentile 95%: sorted bootstrap deltas, values at index int(0.025*B) and int(0.975*B)-1
bootstrap.implementation: numpy.random.default_rng(seed).integers(0, n, size=(chunk, n), dtype=int32) in chunks of 1,000; one index matrix per item set reused for every comparison on that set (paired). Seeds: structure_match set = seed, pipeline_shape set = seed+1, join subgroup = seed+2. NOTE: MQL-0011 used random.Random, so CIs are not byte-comparable across MQL-0011 and MQL-0012.

statistics.X1_test: superiority on structure_match: p_X1 = exact McNemar two-sided p (X1 vs R3)
statistics.X2_test: non-inferiority, margin -1.0 pp, on BOTH structure_match and pipeline_shape (intersection-union: both must pass, no within-X2 adjustment). One-sided bootstrap p per metric = (1 + #{bootstrap delta <= -1.0 pp}) / (B + 1); p_X2 = max of the two
statistics.multiplicity: Holm over {p_X1, p_X2} at family alpha 0.05

acceptance.X1_pass: ALL of: (1) X1 - R3 structure_match >= +2.0 pp; (2) paired bootstrap 95% CI lower bound > 0; (3) X1 - R3 on the join subgroup >= -2.0 pp; (4) p_X1 survives Holm
acceptance.X2_pass: ALL of: (1) structure_match 95% CI lower bound of X2 - R3 > -1.0 pp; (2) pipeline_shape 95% CI lower bound of X2 - R3 > -1.0 pp; (3) p_X2 survives Holm
acceptance.interpretation_rules: a non-significant difference is not evidence of equivalence; X2 failing non-inferiority does not show BM25 is needed; structure-proxy changes are not execution-accuracy changes; thresholds are never changed after registration

power.assumptions: n_attainable ~ 2,872 (= 3,295 x 679/779, estimate from the dev attainability rate), n_shape = 2,405 corpus-record items; discordance rates from MQL-0011 dev: R3 vs R0 9.1%, R2 vs R3 24%
power.X1: P(CI lower bound > 0 | true +2 pp) = 0.95 / 0.79 / 0.59 at 9 / 15 / 24% discordance; P(pass criteria 1-2 | true +3 pp) = 0.96 / 0.90 / 0.78; at a true +2.0 pp criterion (1) alone has ~50% chance
power.X2: UNDERPOWERED for equivalence: P(pass both margins | true difference 0) = 0.16 / 0.07 / 0.03; | true +0.5 pp: 0.53 / 0.26 / 0.12. X2 can realistically pass only if it is genuinely at least as good as R3. Registered as specified anyway; a FAIL is not evidence that BM25 is needed.

validation_before_x0: R3 (unchanged MQL-0011 class, Qdrant, dev cache) reproduces the registered MQL-0011 dev R3 top-3 for 779/779 items and the registered R0 top-3 for 779/779
FlexRetriever(bm25+dense, regex) returns rankings identical to R3 on all 779 MQL-0011 dev items
no X1/X2 outcome metric is computed on dev or X0 before registration
coverage_analysis: separate descriptive finding: X0 and dev items whose gold signature is absent from the view, by missing label; no corpus change
provenance_disclosure: X1 and X2 were selected from a post-hoc analysis of MQL-0011 DEV results. X0 databases appeared in that analysis only as retrieved candidate documents (doc-side signatures/skeletons), never as queries; no X0 query outcome has been computed before this registration. Week 3 (2026) selected hybrid weight 1.0 by train-LODO on corpus v1, which may have included some build-DB questions (not verified); that choice is part of R3/X1/X2 alike.
